collection_note: Run and safe-output counts use 30 log batches; the last page returned no continuation and there were no runs in the remaining gap before the 24-hour boundary. GitHub API engagement and quality fields are null because the issue search response was integrity-filtered and the available MCP tools do not expose a discussion listing/reply reader, so workflow-created-item engagement could not be enumerated completely.
